reason: Development dependency of @vscode/vsce through @azure/identity (no release of @azure/identity allows the fixed @azure/msal-node 7.1 yet). The advisory affects only the authorization code flow (acquireTokenByCode); vsce authenticates with EnvironmentCredential, AzureCliCredential, ManagedIdentityCredential, AzurePowerShellCredential and AzureDeveloperCliCredential, none of which use it. Remove when @azure/identity accepts @azure/msal-node >=7.1.0.

Transitive dependency of @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree (minimatch ^10.2.2). The advisory affects pattern amplification when optimizationLevel >= 2 on untrusted user-supplied glob patterns; typescript-estree uses it internally with default options during local AST parsing. Remove when @typescript-eslint updates to minimatch >=11.0.1.

Transitive dependency of @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree through tinyglobby; no fixed picomatch release exists (4.0.7 is the last affected). typescript-estree calls tinyglobby only in resolveProjectList, for the `project` parser option; the engine, CLI and extension call parse() only and never pass `project`, so no glob pattern, user-supplied or otherwise, reaches picomatch. Remove when a fixed picomatch is released.
